purpose: Formal quality gates separating high-performing capture operations from chaotic ad-hoc editing
principle: Iterative, peer-reviewed checkpoints ensuring compliance, persuasion, and strategic alignment

blue_team.focus: Overarching capture strategy, competitive positioning, initial win themes
key_questions: Is the opportunity worth pursuing? (Go/No-Go validated)
Are win themes viable and differentiated?
Is competitive intelligence sufficient for ghosting strategy?
Are teaming partnerships secured?
blue_team.exit_criteria: Approved capture plan with funded resource commitment
blue_team.reviewers: Capture Manager, BD Lead, Executive Sponsor

key_questions: Are writers correctly interpreting the win strategy?
Is the compliance matrix fully populated?
Do storyboards reflect customer-centric messaging?
Are graphics concepts identified?
pink_team.exit_criteria: Validated outlines and storyboards ready for full drafting
pink_team.reviewers: Proposal Manager, Volume Leads, Compliance Lead

red_team.focus: MOST CRITICAL milestone — independent grading against RFP evaluation criteria
key_questions: Does the proposal score competitively against evaluation criteria?
Are there fatal flaws in compliance, messaging, or technical approach?
Is the narrative customer-centric or self-congratulatory?
Are all 7 sources of proof deployed at claim points?
Would this proposal beat the competition?
red_team.exit_criteria: All fatal flaws identified with remediation plan and owner assigned
red_team.reviewers: Independent reviewers (NOT original authors), simulating customer evaluation

key_questions: Is cost narrative consistent with technical approach?
Is estimating logic defensible and documented?
Are hidden costs exposed (ghosting in pricing)?
Is domestic preference calculation accurate (for MENA)?
Does pricing support win without sacrificing margin?
green_team.reviewers: CFO/Finance Lead, Pricing Analyst, Capture Manager

gold_team.focus: Ultimate executive review for submission authority
key_questions: Is organizational risk acceptable?
Are legal and contractual commitments within policy?
Is final pricing authorized?
Are all mandatory signatures and bonds secured?
What worked well in this bid cycle?
What process breakdowns occurred?
Which boilerplate content is reusable?
What competitive intelligence was validated/invalidated?
How should P-Win scoring be recalibrated?
white_team.exit_criteria: Lessons documented, reusable content archived, P-Win model updated

consolidation_options.small_firms: Merge Pink + Red into single mid-cycle evaluation
consolidation_options.simple_contracts: Skip Green Team for firm-fixed-price contracts
consolidation_options.rapid_turnaround: Combine Blue + Pink into a single strategy-and-outline gate
consolidation_options.principle: Maintain core principle of objective evaluation while preserving agility
